text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis and preview in the opening paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay sets up its position and main reasons early, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"uses article language like \"none of the cars developed so far are completely driverless\"","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its claims in specific details and quotations from the source article."},{"evidence":"explains why partial automation \"defeats the purpose\" of driverless cars","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more often connects evidence to its claim with explicit explanation rather than just asserting a point."},{"evidence":"body paragraphs focused on separate concerns about functionality and safety","quality":"paragraph development","description":"The essay develops distinct points in a more structured way across its body paragraphs."},{"evidence":"concluding paragraph restates the argument and sums up the stakes","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by reinforcing the main claim and briefly synthesizing the reasons given."}]}
